Current linked policy applicability heading is for vehicle purchases and SIRA starts on or after 1 March 2026. Its URL and footer retain January 2026 wording. hyundai_ioniq_6_n_current__n_84_kwh_awd_.conditions: Initial cover starts at warranty commencement; participating dealer/direct Hyundai supply and plan terms apply. Rental buyers and taxis are excluded. Renewal runs 24 months from a scheduled service at a participating Hyundai dealer; lifetime support is conditional on continued qualifying servicing. Out-of-charge support includes a tow to the nearest charging point, subject to policy limitations. The towing clause covers vehicles weighing less than 2,500 kg at breakdown; heavier vehicles or specialist equipment can incur driver-paid recovery. This restriction is material to IONIQ 9. Accident, off-road rescue, motorsport and other exclusions apply; not every tyre, towing or onward-travel cost is free. The EV terms are headed 1 September 2025 but retain an olderApril 2024 information sentence; the version is retained as published. Earlier IONIQ 5 epochs before V.3 are not automatically assigned the 24-month explicit IONIQ wording. Any such residual identity requires separate applicability review.

volkswagen_id_buzz_my26__pro_swb__1.value: 2 years included
volkswagen_id_buzz_my26__pro_swb__1.conditions: Initial Volkswagen Assist membership is 24 months from the new-vehicle warranty start date. The policy separately names eTransporter as a 12-month exception; that Tier 2 family is outside this Tier 1 inheritance. An eligible scheduled service at an authorised Volkswagen dealer provides or tops up SIRA to as much as 24 months. It activates within 48 hours; remaining membership is topped up, not stacked by adding another 24 months. Essential Service and Essential Service Plus are not qualifying scheduled services for SIRA. hyundai_inster_current__extended_range_4.value: 24 months included Premium Roadside Support; qualifying Hyundai dealer service renews 24 months
hyundai_inster_current__extended_range_4.conditions: Initial cover starts at warranty commencement; participating dealer/direct Hyundai supply and plan terms apply. Rental buyers and taxis are excluded. Renewal runs 24 months from a scheduled service at a participating Hyundai dealer; lifetime support is conditional on continued qualifying servicing. Out-of-charge support includes a tow to the nearest charging point, subject to policy limitations. The towing clause covers vehicles weighing less than 2,500 kg at breakdown; heavier vehicles or specialist equipment can incur driver-paid recovery. This restriction is material to IONIQ 9. Accident, off-road rescue, motorsport and other exclusions apply; not every tyre, towing or onward-travel cost is free. The EV terms are headed 1 September 2025 but retain an olderApril 2024 information sentence; the version is retained as published. Earlier IONIQ 5 epochs before V.3 are not automatically assigned the 24-month explicit IONIQ wording. Any such residual identity requires separate applicability review.

warranty.scope: Volkswagen Australia terms for the explicitly reviewed private-buyer Volkswagen BEV versions; commercial-use and eligibility limits remain disclosed
qualifications: New-vehicle cover starts at delivery to the original retail customer; demonstrator cover starts at first dealer registration. A later sale does not restart the period.
Both passenger and commercial vehicles sold on or after 1 January 2019 receive the baseline. No separate passenger-versus-Cargo ID. Buzz base warranty difference is stated.

Proper prescribed maintenance, claim procedures, covered manufacturing/material defects and policy exclusions apply; normal wear, misuse and damage caused by unauthorised modifications are excluded. Australian Consumer Law rights remain.

battery_warranty.basis: Australian BEV high-voltage battery warranty; usable/net capacity relative to initial delivery or registration
battery_warranty.scope: Volkswagen Australia terms for the explicitly reviewed private-buyer Volkswagen BEV versions; commercial-use and eligibility limits remain disclosed
qualifications: Whichever of eight years from initial delivery/registration or 160,000 km occurs first. This is high-voltage-battery cover, separate from the 12 V battery.
Covered components are cell modules, battery housing, cooling elements and battery-module connectors. Capacity is assessed by an authorised Volkswagen dealer using the maker diagnostic procedure.

The policy states the below-70% capacity trigger, then a repair-restoration schedule of 78% at 3 years/60,000 km, 74% at 5 years/100,000 km and 70% at 8 years/160,000 km. The higher values are recorded as restoration levels, not independent trigger thresholds or a promise of restoration to 100%.

The battery provision publishes no separate passenger-ID. Buzz versus Cargo battery period, nor an express use-specific battery mileage table. Its own 8-year/160,000-km limit and general battery exclusions apply; no different commercial battery term is invented.
Misuse, improper battery/charging care, accident damage, unauthorised modifications, permanent removal and other policy exclusions apply.
Warranty terms as published: 8 years / 160,000 km; 70% capacity threshold

qualifications: New-vehicle cover starts at delivery to the original retail customer; demonstrator cover starts at first dealer registration. A later sale does not restart the period.

battery_warranty.basis: Australian BEV high-voltage battery warranty; usable/net capacity relative to initial delivery or registration
battery_warranty.scope: Volkswagen Australia terms for the explicitly reviewed private-buyer Volkswagen BEV versions; commercial-use and eligibility limits remain disclosed
qualifications: Whichever of eight years from initial delivery/registration or 160,000 km occurs first. This is high-voltage-battery cover, separate from the 12 V battery.
Covered components are cell modules, battery housing, cooling elements and battery-module connectors. Capacity is assessed by an authorised Volkswagen dealer using the maker diagnostic procedure.

The policy states the below-70% capacity trigger, then a repair-restoration schedule of 78% at 3 years/60,000 km, 74% at 5 years/100,000 km and 70% at 8 years/160,000 km. The higher values are recorded as restoration levels, not independent trigger thresholds or a promise of restoration to 100%.

The battery provision publishes no separate passenger-ID. Buzz versus Cargo battery period, nor an express use-specific battery mileage table. Its own 8-year/160,000-km limit and general battery exclusions apply; no different commercial battery term is invented.
Misuse, improper battery/charging care, accident damage, unauthorised modifications, permanent removal and other policy exclusions apply.
Warranty terms as published: 8 years / 160,000 km; 70% capacity threshold
